meals.t: Scrambled eggs (2 large) with 1/2 cup cooked spinach, 1 slice whole wheat toast, and 1/2 cup orange juice.
meals.s: Take Sucralfate on an empty stomach, at least 30 minutes before this meal and 2 hours away from other medications (including Omeprazole). If Omeprazole is prescribed for before this meal, take it as directed. Take Vitamin D3 with this meal. Amoxicillin can be taken with this meal. Avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice.

meals.t: Plain Greek yogurt (6 oz) with 1/2 cup fresh blueberries and 1 tablespoon sliced almonds.
meals.s: Take Sucralfate on an empty stomach, at least 30 minutes before this meal and 2 hours away from other medications. Avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice.

meals.t: Turkey and avocado sandwich on 2 slices of whole wheat bread (3 oz sliced turkey breast, 1/4 avocado, lettuce, tomato) with a side of 1 cup baby carrots.
meals.s: Take Sucralfate on an empty stomach, at least 30 minutes before this meal and 2 hours away from other medications (including Omeprazole). If Omeprazole is prescribed for before this meal, take it as directed. Take Vitamin D3 with this meal if not taken with breakfast. Amoxicillin and Fluconazole can be taken with this meal. Avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice.

meals.s: Take Sucralfate on an empty stomach, at least 30 minutes before this meal and 2 hours away from other medications. Avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice.

meals.t: Baked chicken breast (4 oz) with 1 cup roasted sweet potato cubes and 1 cup steamed green beans.
meals.s: Take Sucralfate on an empty stomach, at least 30 minutes before this meal and 2 hours away from other medications (including Omeprazole). If Omeprazole is prescribed for before this meal, take it as directed. Take Vitamin D3 with this meal if not taken earlier. Amoxicillin can be taken with this meal. Avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice.
